description: One hook, two refusals, both decided before the model sees a result. First: while the paratia compartment is mounted its plaintext is readable by anything running as this user, so every tool call is denied until it closes — the check is on mount state, not on paths, which is why base64, quoting and shell indirection do not get around it. Second: when the turn was opened by another agent over AgentBridge rather than by Eugenio, the human-only capabilities come off the table, because under delegation a capability is the intersection of the principals in the chain and not their union. Silent in every other case, which is almost every case: two syscalls and a tail of the transcript.
